"'''The Sequential Passage of Chronological Intervals'''" was a [[Music/Legends|song]] originally performed by [[Gaeriel Capens]] and composed by a [[TribBot mimic series]] droid during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. It was later covered by [[Figrin D'an and the Modal Nodes/Legends|Figrin D'an and the Modal Nodes]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].
